test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements regarding the income tax–related announcements in the Union Budget 2026–27 is ***INCORRECT***?

options.text: The Union Budget 2026–27 retained the existing income tax rates and slabs without any change.
The timeline for filing revised income tax returns has been extended from December 31 to March 31 with a nominal fee.
Tax Collection at Source (TCS) on overseas tour packages has been reduced to 2%
The Securities Transaction Tax on futures has been reduced from 0.02% to 0.01%

solution:
The incorrect option is __**The Securities Transaction Tax (STT) on futures has been reduced from 0.02 per cent to 0.01 per cent to ease the tax burden on investors.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Union Budget 2026–27 kept income tax slabs unchanged while announcing multiple measures to simplify compliance and provide targeted relief to taxpayers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Income tax rates and slabs remain unchanged in the Union Budget 2026–27.**
 
• The deadline for filing revised returns has been extended from December 31 to March 31 with a nominal fee.
 
• TCS on overseas tour packages and on education and medical expenses under LRS has been reduced to 2 per cent.
 
• STT on futures has been increased from 0.02 per cent to 0.05 per cent, not reduced.
 
 
• Hence, Option 4 is ***INCORRECT***.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Revised Return Filing__

 __
 
• Allows taxpayers to correct errors or omissions in previously filed returns.
 
• The extended timeline aims to reduce litigation and improve voluntary compliance.
 
 
 
• Tax Collection at Source (TCS)__
 __
 
• Collected by the seller at the time of transaction and deposited with the government.
 
• Lower TCS rates reduce upfront cash outflow for taxpayers.
 
 
 
• Form 15G and Form 15H__
 __
 
• Self-declaration forms submitted to avoid TDS when income is below the taxable limit.
 
• Now permitted to be submitted through depositories for multiple securities.
 
 
 
• Securities Transaction Tax (STT)__
 
 
• A direct tax levied on transactions in securities traded on recognised stock exchanges.
 
• In Budget 2026–27, STT on futures was increased to 0.05 per cent and on options to 0.15 per cent.
